description: My own approach on English, based on BeastyQT s5 English guide. I will describe Feudal all-in and FC styles here in one BO (f-food, w-wood, g-gold, s-stone)

author: Artori

notes: Build 2 @building_economy/farm.webp@ immediatly, +1f, +3g, first built gvill builds @building_economy/house.png@@building_economy/mining-camp.png@ at @resource/resource_gold.png@
After 7f 3g build 4 on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@. Here, you can either go aggresion, or fast @age/age_3.png@ path

With 3 @resource/sheep.webp@ vills build @landmark_english/council-hall.png@, in aggression style they are going to f after, in FC - on gold. After that, build +1f and construct @building_economy/mill.png@ to get @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.png@

(AGGRO) continue rally on w, build 2 @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@ and go harass against non-cav civs (defend if @civilization_flag/fre.png@@civilization_flag/jda.png@@civilization_flag/mon.png@@civilization_flag/rus.png@). Get @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.png@, build @building_military/barracks.png@. Hire around 3@unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@ and 5@unit_english/longbowman-2.png@ for initial push, then non-stop harass their food>wood>stone>gold

Build a @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ approximately at 6:45 minute mark for @technology_military/steeled-arrow.png@,@technology_military/iron-undermesh.png@ and @technology_military/siege-engineering.png@. Build another @building_military/barracks.png@, start to add @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.png@ at some point and send some men to g
(optional) bring 2 vills to build @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ at enemy base
(FC) after 7f 4w 3g in @age/age_1.webp@, start to rally on f
Start ralling onto w to build  @building_military/stable.webp@ and @building_religious/monastery.png@. Get map control with @unit_cavalry/knight-2.png@ and collect @resource/relics.png@

name: 2TC Standard
author: Valdemar1902

notes: Pull 2 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ away from @resource/resource_gold.png@ to @resource/resource_stone.png@. Rebalance the rest of the vills according to tab on left side.
Rally total of 6 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ (dont mess trees up or you will need a lumbercamp.)
Build 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.png@ with @building_economy/farm.png@-space in between main and 2nd.
@resource/rally.webp@ until 8 on @resource/resource_food.png@. Go up to 15 @unit_worker/villager.png@ on @resource/resource_wood.png@.

For production add @building_military/archery-range.webp@ + @building_military/barracks.png@ and slowly add in @building_economy/farm.png@. You are aiming for at least 25 units at minute 11 since most ram timings hit that time. If they are late, you are usually in a great spot because ROI comes in at that mark.
Try to balance eco now with production by 50/50.
If attack is coming focus on getting +1 ranged attack. Otherwise, focus economy techs and age up after farms.

name: Drongo's 2 TC Fast Castle - optimized for overlay
author: Jargo

notes: @resource/rally.png@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ (evenly chop all 3 trees near your TC)

description:
This build order turns up the tempo knob of English and brings instant pressure.1 maa into feudal spear longbow with upgrades. 

Aim to have about 35 military units at min 10. Practice build order again if you are not reaching at least 30 military units. Macro is extremely important and the only way this build works is if you don't slow yourself down by adding farms and instead use your military advantage to push the game.
name: English Drush Into Heavy Feudal
author: Valdemar1902

notes: 2 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ build @building_military/barracks.png@; 1 @unit_worker/villager.png@ goes to build @building_economy/house.png@ and back to @resource/resource_food.png@.

@resource/rally.webp@1 @unit_worker/villager.png@ to @resource/resource_gold.png@. When 50 @resource/resource_wood.png@ take the 2 @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ to @resource/resource_gold.png@ too.
Pull @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@ and 1 @unit_worker/villager.png@ to build @building_economy/mill.png@ on @resource/berrybush.png@
Aim to have about 35 military units at min 10. Practice build order again if you are not reaching at least 30 military units. Macro is extremely important.
Around min 8-10 is when you add 3 on gold again to get more upgrades.

Depending on how many sheep you gathered, you can move more @unit_worker/villager.webp@to @resource/berrybush.png@. Try not to add farms before min 8-9ish so you can build a military lead/tempo/pressure

macro wise, you will be rallying primarily on wood and add farms with wood vills continously until you have 3 full farm setups. When you have 3 is when you can go castle (you dont have to if you can finish the game in feudal)

When you go castle, you go for @landmark_english/kings-palace.png@ ALWAYS. If you go white tower, you've probably already lost the game. Remember to macro heavy on @resource/resource_gold.png@for upgrades in castle. You are going castle for a timing :)
This build will NOT work vs and you will have to use other strategies: @civilization_flag/rus.png@@civilization_flag/mal.png@@civilization_flag/eng.png@
